posts.name: zerosatanmine
posts.cooked:
My friends and I recently launched the website Capes & Cartridges and I wanted to let the SoTM community know about it.

The site is basically a collection of content related to nerdy interests (sci-fi, anime, superheroes, video games, board/card games, comics, con coverage/pictures, etc).

Right now we have a couple of different podcasts, some comics, music reviews, articles, historical comedy items, and a video of a 8-bit bead sprite being created step by step (sped up). Eventually we want to add some original comedy videos to the site.

I'd love it if you would visit the site and let me know what you think about it. Also, if you like what you see, spread the word and let your friends/family/superhero personas/etc know!

WARNING: The site does feature some vulgar language and a healthy dose of sarcasm.
